title: Headless Big Trouble in Big Town (MS01, TTW)

actions.text: Path: the Big Town sentry lets the player in (stage 10); Pappy asks for the captives to be rescued (20); at the Germantown police station Red is freed from her cell (30) and asks about Shorty (40), Shorty is untied (45); both walk back to Big Town (80, 90); Red pays the reward (50, Complete Quest); the player offers to defend the town (playerDefend), the Super Mutants come (70) and are killed (200, Complete Quest).

Starts with the player out of Vault 101 (the given): Escape! (CG04) done at stage 200, whose script starts Following in His Footsteps (MQ01 stage 10) and Trouble on the Homefront (MS16). [observed: CG04 stage 200 script]
Stand-in for the walk to Big Town: the player at the sentry on the bridge.

Shorty starts in Big Town and his package walks him to Germantown at game start [observed]; a player arriving later finds him there. Here the chain comes at once, so he is moved to his tied-up marker first, as the time on the road would have done.

actions.label: sentry: do you harass all visitors

actions.text: Stand-in for the walk to the Germantown police station; the jailer Super Mutant on the ground floor is killed and searched (the pilot fights), then Red's cell door is unlocked (stand-in for the key or the lock pick) and opened.

Red and Shorty are held in the police station by their packages (MS01RedLockedUp at xMS01RedLockedUp, MS01KitchenWaitForDialog at xMS01ShortyTiedUpMarker) [observed: package data]; the headless world does not carry a package's move into an unloaded cell, so they are put at those markers (stand-in for the AI).

actions.label: milestone: MS01 30 and 40 (Red rescued, asks about Shorty)

actions.text: Down to the basement where Shorty is tied up in the mutants' kitchen; the pilot fights the mutants there. Red comes along (her line sets followingPlayer to -1 [observed: a run]; she is brought along as the follower AI would, a stand-in).

actions.label: shorty: Red is fine, let us go

actions.text: Stand-in for the walk back to Big Town with both following (follower AI): the player and both are moved to the town; each walks into the trigger at the edge of town (MS01MutantTrigger2Script: OnTriggerEnter RedRef sets 80, ShortyREF 90).

actions.label: red: I'll help defend the town

actions.text: The quest script runs on the quest's default processing delay (about 5 s) [observed: a run]; it sees playerDefend, sets stage 70 and enables the Super Mutants.
The Super Mutants enabled by the quest script attack the town: the player kills them (the pilot fights); the last death sets mutantsDealtWith, and the quest script sets stage 200.
